info.name: Export Feature
info.desc: Export resume to PDF format with download options using backend PDF generation. Loads real resume data from API to ensure current user data is exported. Uses WeasyPrint for high-quality PDF generation with better CSS support. Includes success page after download completion. Optimized for mobile devices with responsive design.
info.tech: React, TypeScript, Material-UI, WeasyPrint, Backend PDF Generation, Responsive Design, API Integration
